scope.summary: Implement the DSON read-only import lane per Section 13.26 (file-format strategy P2 verdict): migrate user-owned Daz characters by reading .duf/.dsf morph dials from the user's own Daz library and proposing BodyKit channel mappings — NO .dhdm ingestion, NO Genesis mesh/topology/UV payload, license guard MT-488 enforced fail-closed.
acceptance_criteria: The reader parses user-owned .duf/.dsf (JSON and gzip twin) against a user-configured Daz content root, extracting morph dial names and values plus modifier metadata; missing library references degrade to typed per-item warnings (no silent partial loads).

Import output is a channel-mapping PROPOSAL: suggested BodyKit channel values per recognized dial family (breast/glute/waist/etc.), applied only via explicit recipe creation — never direct authority mesh ingestion.

Genesis mesh geometry, topology, UVs, and .dhdm payloads are NEVER read into authority: the MT-488 license guard rejects graft/geometry payload ingestion with a typed fail-closed reason, tested with a synthetic Genesis-marked fixture.
The lane is explicitly read-only and user-owned-content-only: no bundled Daz data, no redistribution path; the manifest of an imported recipe names its Daz-source provenance for audit.
Formula (ERC) graphs in the DSON are parsed for analysis display (what couplings the Daz character used) without recreating hidden links in BodyKit.
scope.risk_if_missed: Daz users face a cold-start wall (their character library worthless in Handshake) — or, catastrophically, an over-eager importer ingests Genesis-derived payloads and creates the exact EULA violation the license findings flagged.

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Backend/solver scope: behavior is observable via TraceProjection, typed TAILOR_BODY_* receipts, and the 13.12 capture APIs; operator/model GUI exposure rides the BodyKit panes (13.27) and is validated there.

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations.reason: Emits/extends the TAILOR_BODY_* KernelEventType family on the EventLedger per Section 13.16 (extends the 13.14 canonical list).
internal_diagnostics ships with WP-KERNEL-012; wire the open diagnostic-event API for this behavior in the WP-KERNEL-016 retrofit.
Palmistry external watcher ships with WP-KERNEL-012/016; long generation/bake/export runs get child-stall watch coverage in the retrofit.

risks: Broad MT scope can hide multiple review targets.
Markdown MT lists may disagree with packet-declared active/next MT truth.
Receipt routing may target an old MT if contract identity is omitted.
minimum_controls: Exactly one primary proof target per MT unless the packet records why not.
MT identity must be stable and referenced by receipt correlation.
Generated projection drift must not wake Coder or Validator by itself.
